content: Hello, We ended up in a situation when we tried to migrate our Dataverse from one server to another where table controlledvocabularyvalue became very messy!! I think we messed up loading metadata blocks and thus, the table ended up having duplicate values!! We still have the clean table from old DB dumps. Can we simply update the table values based on the old table manually to clean it up? Cheers!!
@Philip Durbin 🚀 Any insight is highly appreciated!! Cheers!!
How exactly I do that without doing a undeploy and deploy of Dataverse? Do you have any resources that I can consult? I looked into docs and Google without any luck!! Thanks

At the end, I took the table from the previous clean dump and updated the values in the new messy table! Seems like it worked (for the moment)!! Hoping the foreign key references are good after this clean up!!
